exercises.title: Activities in the pictures (Lead-in Ex. 1)
exercises.instruction: Match pictures 1–6 with the activities. There are nine activities, so three are not used: shopping, cooking, reading.

items.explanation: hiking — đi bộ đường dài, leo dốc trên núi/đồi với ba lô.
canoeing — chèo xuồng (canoe) bằng mái chèo một bản.
cycling — đạp xe.
sailing — đi thuyền buồm, dùng gió để chạy.
climbing — leo núi/leo vách đá bằng tay và chân.
white water rafting — chèo bè vượt ghềnh (nước chảy xiết, sủi bọt trắng).

exercises.title: Which activity? (Speaking and vocabulary Ex. 15)
exercises.instruction: The pictures show basketball, football, badminton, table tennis, chess, tai chi and kite flying. In which activity do you…?

items.explanation: Bóng rổ: bắt và ném bóng bằng tay.
throw = ném bằng tay → basketball (ném bóng vào rổ).
kick = đá bằng chân → football.
Sách: badminton, table tennis — đánh bằng vợt.
score a goal = ghi bàn (đưa bóng vào khung thành) → football.

items.prompt: …win or lose a match or competition?
items.explanation: Sách: badminton, basketball, table tennis, football, chess — kite flying và tai chi không có thắng thua.
Sách: badminton, basketball, table tennis, football, tai chi.
Sách: badminton, table tennis.
piece = quân cờ.
Sách: kite flying, tai chi.
Sách: basketball, football.
Sách: badminton, table tennis, kite flying, tai chi, chess.
Sách: badminton, basketball, football, table tennis, tai chi.

exercises.title: Sports in the pictures (G&V Ex. 1)
exercises.instruction: Match pictures 1–10 with the names of the sports.

items.explanation: tennis — quần vợt: đánh bóng qua lưới bằng vợt.
volleyball — bóng chuyền: đập bóng bằng tay qua lưới cao.
basketball — bóng rổ: ném bóng vào rổ.
football — bóng đá: đá bóng vào khung thành.
badminton — cầu lông: đánh quả cầu bằng vợt.
swimming — bơi lội.
skiing — trượt tuyết bằng ván trượt đôi.
cycling — đạp xe.
sailing — đi thuyền buồm.
hiking — đi bộ đường dài.

exercises.title: PLAY, DO or GO? (G&V Ex. 2)
exercises.instruction: Put each sport into the correct column.

items.explanation: play + môn chơi với bóng/đối thủ: play tennis.
play + trò chơi có đối thủ: play chess (cờ vua).
Môn bóng → play volleyball.
Môn bóng → play football.
Môn dùng vợt và cầu, thi đấu với đối thủ → play badminton.
Môn bóng/ gậy theo đội → play hockey (khúc côn cầu).
Môn bóng dùng vợt → play table tennis (bóng bàn).
Môn bóng → play basketball.
do + võ thuật/môn tập cá nhân không có bóng: do karate.
Võ thuật → do judo.
Môn đối kháng tập luyện cá nhân → do boxing.
Môn tập luyện (không bóng) → do gymnastics (thể dục dụng cụ).
Võ thuật → do taekwondo.
athletics (điền kinh) là môn tập luyện chung → do athletics.
go + hoạt động đuôi -ing (đi đâu đó để làm): go horse-riding (cưỡi ngựa).
Đuôi -ing → go swimming.
Đuôi -ing → go skiing.
Đuôi -ing → go cycling.
Đuôi -ing → go sailing.
Đuôi -ing → go hiking.
Đuôi -ing → go canoeing.
Đuôi -ing → go fishing (đi câu cá).
Đuôi -ing → go bowling (đi chơi bowling).

exercises.title: Sports verbs (G&V Ex. 3)
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences with the correct form of the verbs in the box: score, win, kick, play, hit, throw, catch, lose, beat.

items.prompt: I'm playing in a tennis tournament tomorrow. I hope I ____ some of my matches.
items.explanation: win (thắng) a match — hi vọng thắng vài trận trong giải đấu.

items.prompt: Our school football team is not doing well this term. Every team we play against ____ us.
items.explanation: beat + đối thủ = đánh bại ai; Every team (số ít) → beats.

items.prompt: I really want to learn how to ____ baseball but it isn't a popular sport in Britain.
items.explanation: learn how to + V nguyên mẫu; chơi môn thể thao → play baseball.

items.prompt: It is quite difficult to learn how to ____ the ball with the racket when you start playing tennis.
items.explanation: hit the ball with the racket = đánh bóng bằng vợt; sau how to → nguyên mẫu hit.

items.prompt: When you ____ a sports match, it is important to learn from your mistakes.
items.explanation: lose a match = thua trận (trái nghĩa với win).

items.prompt: In rugby, players usually pass the ball to each other by ____ it.
items.explanation: Sau giới từ by → V-ing; chuyền bóng bằng tay → throwing.

items.prompt: In football, players can't hold the ball – they must move it by ____ it.
items.explanation: Không được cầm bóng → phải dùng chân: by kicking it.

items.prompt: In baseball, players wear a special glove to help them ____ the ball.
items.explanation: Găng tay đặc biệt giúp bắt bóng → catch; help sb + V nguyên mẫu.

items.prompt: In football and handball, the team that ____ the most goals is the winner.
items.explanation: score goals = ghi bàn; the team (số ít) → scores.

exercises.title: Cricket (G&V Ex. 4)
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct word.

items.prompt: Cricket is a ____ sport in several countries around the world, including India and Britain.
items.explanation: popular = được nhiều người ưa chuộng ở nhiều nước; favourite chỉ sở thích của một người.

items.prompt: There are 11 people in a cricket ____.
items.explanation: 11 người trong một đội → team.

items.prompt: You play the sport by ____ a hard red ball with a bat.
items.explanation: Đánh bóng bằng gậy (bat) → hitting.

items.prompt: It can take five days to complete a cricket ____.
items.explanation: Một trận đấu → match; goal/point là bàn thắng/điểm số.

items.prompt: People often ____ white clothes to play cricket.
items.explanation: Mặc quần áo → wear clothes (không dùng use/put).

exercises.title: What is the article about? (Ex. 12)
exercises.instruction: Skim the article and answer the question.

stimulus.text:
Aimee Fuller was born in England but now lives in the USA. She moved to the east coast of the United States at the age of 12 because she knew she wanted to be a professional snowboarder. It wasn't possible to train properly in her hometown because it hardly ever snowed. There was a dry ski slope in her town, where she learnt how to ski and snowboard, but there weren't any mountains with snow to practise the sport.

Aimee quickly found sponsors and a coach when she arrived in the USA, and she is now a successful and well-known snowboarding star. She has done really well in many national competitions and her dream is to win an Olympic gold medal one day.

Aimee spends most of her time practising on the snow, and trains in the gym four to five times a week. She also goes cycling and running. Aimee says it is very important to keep fit because that helps her stay safe when she is doing snowboarding tricks and jumps. Her advice to people who want to learn how to do jumps, is to start small and only do bigger jumps when they feel ready.

**During her free time, Aimee likes to spend time at home, switch off her phone and laptop and hang out with her friends and family.**
stimulus.caption: Snowboarding star (tr. 38)

options.text: an English snowboarder who lives in the USA

items.explanation: "born in England but now lives in the USA… professional snowboarder".

items.prompt: What sport has Aimee become successful in?
items.explanation: Bài viết nói Aimee là vận động viên trượt ván tuyết (snowboarder) → snowboarding.

items.prompt: What is the reason for this article?

options.text: to tell readers about Aimee's life and career
to explain the rules of snowboarding

items.explanation: Bài giới thiệu cuộc đời và sự nghiệp của Aimee.

exercises.title: Words in the article (Ex. 14)
exercises.instruction: Complete the words from the article that match the definitions.

items.prompt: This is someone who is paid to do a sport or other activity. → p____
items.explanation: professional — vận động viên chuyên nghiệp, được trả tiền để thi đấu.

items.prompt: This means to practise your sport. → t____
items.explanation: train — tập luyện môn thể thao của mình.

items.prompt: This word describes someone who is doing well in his/her life. → s____
items.explanation: successful — thành công, đang làm tốt trong cuộc sống/sự nghiệp.

items.prompt: When you are this, you don't get tired easily when you exercise or do sport. → f____
items.explanation: fit — khoẻ, có thể lực tốt, vận động không bị mệt nhanh.

items.prompt: You ask someone for this when you want to know what to do. → a____
items.explanation: advice — lời khuyên (danh từ không đếm được); hỏi khi muốn biết nên làm gì.

exercises.title: Verbs in the blog (Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: Read the blog from Iceland. Which tense is each verb phrase?

stimulus.text: I'm having a great time here in Iceland. I don't miss home at all. I'm not staying in a hotel. I'm staying at a little guesthouse with 11 other people. Every day, we get up early and go hiking or climbing. At the moment, I'm resting in my room because I'm exhausted. At home, I usually sleep about eight hours a night but on this holiday I need at least 10 hours a night because I'm so active! Our guide is great. He looks after us really well and he always makes us laugh. I'm happy with the food, but my friend doesn't like it very much. Today, we're having reindeer burgers. The chef is cooking them now and they smell delicious.
stimulus.caption: MY BLOG — Iceland

items.explanation: Thói quen hằng ngày (dậy lúc mấy giờ) → hiện tại đơn: we get up.
don't + V → dạng phủ định của hiện tại đơn.
Có trạng từ tần suất usually → hiện tại đơn.
looks (thêm -s, ngôi 3) → hiện tại đơn; việc anh ấy thường làm.
always + makes → hiện tại đơn (thói quen).
doesn't like → hiện tại đơn; like là động từ trạng thái.
am + having → hiện tại tiếp diễn: đang có khoảng thời gian tuyệt vời ngay lúc viết.
am not + staying → hiện tại tiếp diễn (phủ định), việc tạm thời trong chuyến đi.
am + resting → đang nghỉ ngơi ngay lúc này.
are + having → hiện tại tiếp diễn: đang ăn (bữa tối hôm nay).
is + cooking → hiện tại tiếp diễn: đầu bếp đang nấu.

exercises.title: Rules for the tenses (Ex. 7, 9)
exercises.instruction: Choose "simple" or "continuous".

items.prompt: We use the present ____ with time words and phrases, such as at the moment, today and now.
items.explanation: at the moment / today / now = đang xảy ra lúc nói → present continuous.

items.prompt: We use the present ____ with adverbs, such as always, sometimes, usually and every day.
items.explanation: always, sometimes, usually, every day = tần suất → present simple.

items.prompt: We use the present ____ to talk about habits and routines.
items.explanation: Thói quen, việc lặp lại → present simple.

items.prompt: We use the present ____ to describe the action in photographs.
items.explanation: Mô tả hành động trong ảnh (đang diễn ra trong ảnh) → present continuous.

items.prompt: When you make a question in the present ____, use the auxiliary verb do.
items.explanation: Câu hỏi hiện tại đơn dùng trợ động từ do/does: Do you…?

items.prompt: When you make a question in the present ____, use the question form of the verb to be.
items.explanation: Câu hỏi hiện tại tiếp diễn đảo be lên đầu: Are you…?

exercises.title: -s and -ing forms (Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Write the third person (-s/-es/-ies) form and the -ing form of the verbs.

items.explanation: lives (thêm -s); living (bỏ e câm rồi thêm -ing).
gets; getting — một âm tiết, kết thúc phụ âm–nguyên âm–phụ âm → gấp đôi t.
carries (phụ âm + y → ies); carrying (giữ y khi thêm -ing).
hopes; hoping — bỏ e câm trước -ing.
runs; running — gấp đôi n (phụ âm–nguyên âm–phụ âm).
lies; lying — đuôi -ie đổi thành y trước -ing.
cries (y → ies); crying (giữ y).
makes; making — bỏ e câm.
begins; beginning — trọng âm ở âm cuối (be'gin) → gấp đôi n.

exercises.title: Questions and answers in two tenses (Ex. 9)
exercises.instruction: Match questions 1–4 with answers A–D.

items.right: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
items.explanation: Hỏi bằng Are you…? → trả lời ngắn bằng be: Yes, I am / No, I'm not.

items.left: What are you doing at the moment?
items.explanation: What are you doing at the moment? hỏi việc đang làm → trả lời bằng tiếp diễn: I'm having a rest.

items.left: Do you usually get up early?
items.right: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
items.explanation: Hỏi bằng Do you…? → trả lời ngắn bằng do: Yes, I do / No, I don't.

items.left: When does your brother get up?
items.explanation: When…? hỏi thời gian → trả lời bằng giờ: At about 7am.

exercises.title: A conversation – verb forms (Ex. 10)
exercises.instruction: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or present continuous.

items.prompt: A: Hi, Gabby. What ____ (you/do) at the moment? Do you ____ (want) to go out somewhere?
items.explanation: at the moment → tiếp diễn: are you doing; want là động từ trạng thái → Do you want.

items.prompt: B: I can't, sorry. I ____ (watch) a football match on TV. My team usually ____ (play) really well but they ____ (lose) very badly today!
items.explanation: Đang xem lúc nói → 'm watching; usually → hiện tại đơn plays; today (đang diễn ra) → are losing.

items.prompt: A: Tom, I ____ (wait) for you outside the cinema. — B: I'm sorry, this bus never ____ (arrive) on time.
items.explanation: Đang đứng chờ lúc gọi → 'm waiting; never (thói quen của xe buýt) → arrives.

items.prompt: Sam ____ (not answer) my calls today. — He's got a French exam next week, so he ____ (study) at the moment.
items.explanation: today: việc đang diễn ra trong hôm nay → isn't answering; at the moment → 's studying.

items.prompt: How do you usually ____ (get) to college? — I ____ (walk). It ____ (not take) long.
items.explanation: usually → hiện tại đơn: get, walk; It (ngôi 3) phủ định → doesn't take.

items.prompt: My Dad usually ____ (drive) me there but he ____ (work) today.
items.explanation: usually → drives (ngôi 3); today (khác thường lệ) → 's working.

exercises.title: Make questions (Ex. 11)
exercises.instruction: Put the words in the correct order to make questions.

items.explanation: Wh- + are + you + V-ing: hỏi lý do đang học tiếng Anh (việc diễn ra trong giai đoạn này).
Wh- + do + you + usually + V: usually đứng ngay trước động từ chính.
at the moment → tiếp diễn: What are you learning about…? giới từ about đi sau learning.
Câu hỏi Yes/No hiện tại đơn: Do + you + play + tennis?
now → tiếp diễn: What is the teacher doing now?

exercises.title: Notes: a film festival (Ex. 21)
exercises.instruction: Read the advert and Andrew's email, then complete Joshua's notes.

stimulus.text:
FILM FESTIVAL IN SUNNYHILL PARK — Saturday 23rd and Sunday 24th June
2:00PM Blue Rain · 4:00PM Child in Time
TICKETS: £20 on the day or £15 from www.parkcinema.com
Also available – food stalls, art and other activities

To: Joshua · From: Andrew
Hi Joshua, I'm emailing you about the film festival at the weekend. I can only go on Saturday as I'm working on Sunday. I don't mind if we miss Blue Rain, but I can't wait to see Child in Time! We can get food there, but don't forget an umbrella as it looks like the weather won't be good. I'll get the tickets online tonight and you can pay me then. See you at the entrance at 1:00pm. Andrew
stimulus.caption: Ex. 21 — Place: Sunnyhill Park (ví dụ)

items.explanation: Andrew: "I can only go on Saturday as I'm working on Sunday." Quảng cáo: Saturday 23rd and Sunday 24th June.
Andrew mua vé online tối nay → giá online £15 (mua tại chỗ £20).
"See you at the entrance at 1:00pm."
"I don't mind if we miss Blue Rain, but I can't wait to see Child in Time!"
"don't forget an umbrella as it looks like the weather won't be good."

exercises.title: What does Richard want? (Ex. 22)
exercises.instruction: You and Andrew are at the film festival. Richard sends you a text message.

stimulus.text:
Hi Joshua,
Where are you? Are you busy? I'm watching TV at home at the moment but I'm really bored.
Do you want to meet up? Let me know soon!
Richard
stimulus.caption: Message from Richard

items.prompt: What does Richard want to do?

options.text: watch TV at home with you

items.explanation: "Do you want to meet up? Let me know soon!"

exercises.title: Write a reply to Richard (Ex. 23)
exercises.instruction: Use the information in this unit to write a reply to Richard (about 60–90 words). Include: where you are · who you are with · what you are doing · what is happening · where you can meet Richard · what Richard should bring. Use the present simple and present continuous correctly.

checklist: Dùng hiện tại tiếp diễn cho việc đang xảy ra
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Hi Richard,

Yes, that would be great! I'm in Sunnyhill Park at the moment, at a film festival with Andrew. We're watching Child in Time – it's fantastic! Lots of people are sitting on the grass and some are eating at the food stalls. The next film starts at 4pm. You can meet us at the entrance near the car park. Bring some money for food and an umbrella as it may rain.

See you soon,
Joshua
commonErrors: Dùng hiện tại đơn cho việc đang xảy ra (We watch a film now)
Thiếu 1–2 ý trong 6 gạch đầu dòng

exercises.title: Which activities are mentioned? (Ex. 4)
exercises.instruction: Which of these activities DOES Deon mention?

items.explanation: "He went on one of their cycling holidays last year".
Deon không nhắc tới shopping (một trong ba hoạt động không dùng ở Lead-in).
"in the forest where you can do hiking and cooking".
Có nói "water sports" nhưng không nói canoeing.
"in the mountains… climbing and white water rafting".
"The sailing holidays are eight hundred pounds".

exercises.title: Speaking: your free-time activities (Ex. 3, 20)
exercises.instruction: Answer each question in 15–25 seconds.

items.prompt: What activities do you like doing in your free time?
items.sampleAnswer: In my free time I usually play badminton with my friends after school. I also love reading comics because it helps me relax before I go to sleep.
items.sampleNote: 2 hoạt động + tần suất + lý do.

items.prompt: Which sports do you like doing? Which sports do you watch on TV?
items.sampleAnswer: I like swimming because it's good exercise and it keeps me fit. On TV, I usually watch football with my dad, especially when Vietnam is playing.
items.sampleNote: Tách 2 ý: chơi gì / xem gì.

items.prompt: Is it important to spend time outdoors? Why or why not?
items.sampleAnswer: Yes, I think so. We spend too much time looking at screens, so going outside helps us feel healthier and happier. For example, I feel much better after a walk in the park.

items.prompt: What activities are popular in your country?
items.sampleAnswer: Football is definitely the most popular sport in Vietnam. Lots of young people also like playing badminton in the park and going out with friends for coffee at the weekend.

exercises.title: Speaking: describe two pictures of a park (Ex. 19)
exercises.instruction: Look at Picture 1 and Picture 2. Speak for about one minute: describe what is happening in each picture and give 3–5 similarities and 3–5 differences. Use the present continuous.

items.prompt: Describe Picture 1 and Picture 2. Say what is happening in each picture, and find things that are the same and different.
items.sampleAnswer: In both pictures, I can see a big park with lots of trees and green grass, and people are doing exercise. In picture 1, a man is riding a bike at the top and a woman is lying on a bench. In the middle, some people are standing on a red mat and talking. A father is walking with his son and holding hands. In picture 2, there is no bike, but a person is running at the bottom. In the middle, a group of people are doing yoga, and on the right a man is doing push-ups. So the main difference is that people in picture 2 are more active.
items.sampleNote: Mở bằng điểm chung (In both pictures), rồi lần lượt tranh 1 → tranh 2, có vị trí (at the top, in the middle, on the right), kết bằng nhận xét.

exercises.title: Odd one out (G&V Ex. 5)
exercises.instruction: Choose the word that is DIFFERENT from the others.

items.explanation: Các từ khác là water sports (thể thao dưới nước).
Các từ khác là team sports.
Các từ khác là hành động trong khi chơi thể thao (actions used in sports).
Các từ khác là các loại cuộc thi (types of competition).
Các từ khác là mountain sports.
Các từ khác là dụng cụ thể thao (sports equipment).

exercises.title: Third person and -ing forms (G&V Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: Write the third person singular (present simple) and the -ing form of each verb.

items.explanation: snows (+s); snowing (+ing, w không gấp đôi).
-x → thêm -es.
Phụ âm–nguyên âm–phụ âm → gấp đôi t: getting.
stops; stopping — phụ âm–nguyên âm–phụ âm → gấp đôi p.
Tận cùng -e → bỏ e rồi thêm -ing.
Phụ âm + y → -ies; nhưng -ing giữ nguyên y.
-sh → -es.
makes; making — bỏ e câm trước -ing.
Trọng âm ở âm đầu (OF-fer) → không gấp đôi r.
Nguyên âm + y → chỉ thêm -s.
-ss → -es.
copies (phụ âm + y → ies); copying (giữ y).
dances; dancing — bỏ e câm.
swims; swimming — gấp đôi m.
happens; happening — trọng âm ở âm đầu ('hap-pen) → không gấp đôi n.
Anh-Anh gấp đôi l: travelling (Anh-Mỹ: traveling).

exercises.title: Match the sentence halves (G&V Ex. 7)
exercises.instruction: Match the two halves of the sentences.

items.explanation: is working (tạm thời) + in Italy at the moment — at the moment khớp với tiếp diễn.

items.left: I often go to the cinema
items.explanation: often go (thói quen, hiện tại đơn) + on a Saturday evening.

items.left: I can't speak to you right now
items.explanation: right now → lý do đang diễn ra: because I'm studying.

items.right: like doing in his free time?
items.explanation: What does your brother + like doing…? (like + V-ing; trợ động từ does đi với hiện tại đơn).
Mô tả ảnh → tiếp diễn: I'm climbing + a volcano (tân ngữ của climb).
What do you usually do + at the weekend? (usually → hiện tại đơn).
Why isn't Sam + eating his sandwich? (isn't + V-ing → tiếp diễn).

exercises.title: State verbs (G&V Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form.

items.prompt: ____ how to play tennis, but I would like to learn.
items.explanation: know là state verb → không dùng tiếp diễn.
remember là động từ trạng thái (không dùng tiếp diễn) → I can't remember.

items.prompt: Can you help me with my homework? ____ this question.
items.explanation: understand là động từ trạng thái → I don't understand.

items.prompt: John ____ a great time on holiday. Look at these pictures on his blog!
items.explanation: have a great time = hành động (trải qua) → được dùng tiếp diễn.

items.prompt: It ____ to my sister and she ____ it at the moment.
items.explanation: belong là state verb; "at the moment" → is reading.

items.prompt: ____ go out tonight. I'm too tired!
items.explanation: want là động từ trạng thái → I don't want to.

items.prompt: My brother ____ so many hobbies! At the moment, he ____ photos in the garden.
items.explanation: have (sở hữu) là state verb; at the moment → is taking.

items.prompt: Sue ____ you at the moment. She ____ a shower.
items.explanation: hear là động từ trạng thái → can't hear; have a shower là hành động đang diễn ra → is having.

exercises.title: Katy's email from Leeds (G&V Ex. 9)
exercises.instruction: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or present continuous.

items.prompt: I ____ (have) a great time here in Leeds. The city is really big and it ____ (have) so many interesting places to visit.
items.explanation: have a great time là hành động (đang tận hưởng) → am having; has = sở hữu (trạng thái) → hiện tại đơn.

items.prompt: I ____ (enjoy) my course so far and I really ____ (like) my classmates.
items.explanation: so far, việc đang diễn ra → am enjoying; like là động từ trạng thái → like.

items.prompt: I ____ (stay) in one of the halls of residence this year.
items.explanation: this year = sắp xếp tạm thời → am staying.

items.prompt: I ____ (have got) a job in a local restaurant. I ____ (work) there three evenings a week.
items.explanation: have got = có (sở hữu, trạng thái) → have got; three evenings a week (lịch đều đặn) → work.

items.prompt: It's fine, but at the moment I ____ (look) for another job. I ____ (want) one that ____ (finish) a bit earlier.
items.explanation: at the moment → am looking; want là động từ trạng thái → want; one (công việc) ngôi 3 → finishes.

exercises.title: Short answers (G&V Ex. 10)
exercises.instruction: Match the questions with the correct short answers.

items.left: Is that your brother playing tennis over there?
items.explanation: Is that…? → Yes, it is (that → it).

items.left: Do you always get up so early?
items.explanation: Do you…? → Yes, I do.

items.left: Are your parents staying in a hotel?
items.explanation: Are your parents…? → Yes, they are.
Are you…? → No, I'm not.

items.left: Is your brother having a good time in Iceland?
items.explanation: Is your brother…? → Yes, he is.

items.left: Do you and your parents always eat together in the evenings?
items.explanation: Do you and your parents…? (you and your parents = we) → No, we don't.

items.left: Look at this picture of me as a young child. Am I wearing your gold necklace?
items.explanation: Am I…? → người nghe trả lời về 'you': Yes, you are.

items.left: Do any of your school friends do taekwondo?
items.explanation: Do any of your friends…? (số nhiều → they) → No, they don't.
